text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of her adventure, Hishi Akebono 
obtained the 'Legendary Kitchen Knife.' 
However—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"And you see~, it hasn't been cared for in 
so long that it's no sharper than an 
ordinary kitchen knife!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"All the listeners are shocked too! But, 
but the gatekeeper said, 'Sharpen it with 
a special whetstone and it'll revive'...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"‘So next, I'm going to search for a 
whetstone! It'll probably be a tough 
journey, but... I don't want to give up!’"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, finding a pearl among the stones 
sounds so exciting! Come on, let's go on 
an adventure!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If it's a rough road, I want to support 
you. Take me along with you, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You're so admirable that I just couldn't 
sit still!! As a member of the Akebono-san 
Channel Fan Club, I shall assist with all 
my heart and soul!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...! Nnngh, Buono! That's so, so 
reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading straight to the location the 
keeper mentioned, we set out with the 
locals to find stones that could be turned 
into whetstones...

text_block_list.name: Whetstone Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
It's dark around here, so watch your 
step~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gabarabera! Gaba-gaba-gaba!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, Digital-chan!? Oh no, she's being 
washed away!
choice_data_list:
I'm pulling you up now! Everyone, lend a 
hand!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*cough* *hack*... I-I'm so sorry! I've 
caused trouble for both of you...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I thought there might be rocks on the 
riverbed... So I tried to look for them 
ahead of time...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Digital-chan is an important companion 
too! Let's search together, not by 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwaaah~... Uwahh, thank you so much~~!

text_block_list.name: Whetstone Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
They used to find stones around here too, 
though...
choice_data_list:
We can't seem to find the stone we're 
looking for...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Pearl oysters don't make 
pearls in a day, and hunting for stones 
takes passion and guts too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You're right! Gotta look even closer...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! A star in the rough can be 
found in the most unexpected places!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Nnnnghhhh...! Nuh!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I was just thinking that stone 
over there looks just like a piece of 
meat~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But we're doing great! Let's keep up 
the patient search like this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that really worked up a sweat...! 
Let's get changed before we catch a chill!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I brought some sweat wipes and ice packs, 
so feel free to use them if you need 
them."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! As for me, I brought seasoned 
rice balls~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of Akebono. Shall we go 
eat under the shade of that tree over 
there?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it's salty and delicious! The 
texture of the mushrooms is fun too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right~? I figured you'd be moving around a 
lot, so I made the seasoning a bit richer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
My stomach is full, and I feel totally 
refreshed! I'm fully recharged~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah. Alright, let's work up another 
sweat...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside the enthusiastic Umamusume, the 
search for whetstone materials continued, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Whetstone Craftsman
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I couldn't find it for you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I couldn't find it today, but I'm 
sure I will next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: More・im・por・tantly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank everyone who helped out so 
much! You must be starving, right?
choice_data_list:
After all, "an army marches on its 
stomach" and all that.

After all, "an army marches on its 
stomach" and all that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right♪ I've gotta recharge my 
energy for next time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~... Warm tonjiru really soothes the 
soul~...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, Akebono's cooking is always 
delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks! Once the legendary kitchen 
knife is finished, I'll cook you even 
tastier meals, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
However, I really love today's tonjiru 
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sweating a ton, making the salty food 
taste amazing. Sitting together in a 
circle, laughing over how tired we were.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Because it's a delicious flavor that 
can only be brought out right here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Just like how a book bought 
directly from the creator's hands after 
braving the heat and cold shines so 
brightly—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I believe this single cup is something you 
can only truly appreciate right here! It's 
exceptionally delicious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"A taste of memories that surpasses all 
else... If you put it that way... let me 
see."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is the taste of our adventure.

text_block_list.name: Whetstone Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Today's meal is 
extraordinary! Even without a knife... No, 
in fact, it's bound to taste even better 
than if we had one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, is that so? ...Yeah, uh-huh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, me! Is it okay if I make one 
more dish!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I got a call from the 
whetstone craftsman. To my surprise, he 
found the stone and said he'd send over a 
whetstone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I seeee! Fufu, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll make something delicious! 
Not just because it's the 'Legendary 
Knife,' but something even better than 
that... you'll see!
